verdict.rationale: Stripe runs many background processes on its own. Billing automates recurring payments, trials and renewals; Smart Retries recovers failed payments with no code; webhooks and event destinations push real-time events to drive your own automations. User-configured no-code workflows triggered by Stripe events, however, are documented only through the third-party Kyber app in the Stripe Apps marketplace, and the AI tooling (MCP, plugins) is interactive, with human confirmation required for some write actions. Missing for 10: a first-party automation/workflow builder, AI-agent-driven background automations configurable by the user, and hands-on corroboration.
